fields.description: Human-readable name for this leg, e.g. "Fuel Urea Expenses - Driver Incentive". Once saved, change it with the Rename option in the ⋯ menu — that keeps the label, the record ID, and every reconciliation already pointing at it in sync.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: "Both" means a single target record is eligible on either leg of a bank statement (e.g. a Payment of type "Bank Transfer" — Debit on the source account via the fields below, Credit on the destination account via the Credit Leg fields) — fill in the Credit Leg section too when this is set.
fields.label: Direction

fields.description: Auto-assigned on creation (next available number) — priority order used to auto-resolve an Ambiguous statement row when more than one candidate record (possibly across different sources) shares the same date and amount, lower sequence tried first. Ties fall back to record creation order (oldest first).
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: Uncheck for target doctypes that are not submittable (docstatus is always 0) — Repair Expenses, Tyre Expenses, Battery Expenses, Compliances, and Service Logs are not submittable in this app, so eligible records are found without a docstatus filter for those.
fields.label: Requires Submitted (docstatus=1)

fields.description: Which date on the target doctype should be matched against the bank statement date.
fields.label: Date Field

fields.description: Which amount on the target doctype should be matched against the bank statement amount.
fields.label: Amount Field

fields.description: Which field holds the Bank Account (Account Head) that the money moved through.
fields.label: Bank Account Field

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fieldnames from the target doctype to show (alongside its date and amount) when picking a Matched Record on an Unmatched/Ambiguous transaction row — e.g. "vehicle,document_type" for Compliances.
fields.label: Display Fields (for Matched Record picker)

fields.description: The Check field that gets ticked on the target record once it is reconciled.
fields.label: Reconciled Checkbox Field

fields.description: The Link field that stores which TMS Bank Reconciliation reconciled the target record.
fields.label: Reconciliation Link Field

fields.description: Which field holds the Bank Account (Account Head) for the Credit (incoming) leg — e.g. Payment.transfer_to_account.
fields.label: Bank Account Field (Credit Leg)

fields.description: The Check field ticked once the Credit leg is reconciled — e.g. Payment.is_reconciled_in.
fields.label: Reconciled Checkbox Field (Credit Leg)

fields.description: The Link field storing which TMS Bank Reconciliation reconciled the Credit leg — e.g. Payment.bank_reconciliation_in.
fields.label: Reconciliation Link Field (Credit Leg)
